claim: QST-SIM-0002 now has an accepted finite-time stale-coverage measurement primitive and an accepted two-constant-rotation-regime measurement under an identical body-fixed synthetic observation schedule, without a demonstrated policy advantage.

provenance.source_title: Measure stale coverage under two constant rotation regimes
limitations: Identical body-fixed observations yielded equal traces and do not establish a policy or architecture advantage.
Irregular/tumbling rotation and new shadow physics remain outside scope.
provenance.fact_summary: The stale-coverage metric was repaired to reject non-finite time inputs; the later two-regime artifact was reproducible and ultimately merged after governance receipt correction.
provenance.inference_summary: SNS has a stronger policy-neutral measurement boundary for future surveying experiments.
provenance.speculation_summary: A higher-information observation geometry may reveal rotation-regime effects if authorized without embedding a survey-policy preference.
